heading: Automatic updates install again
summary: Updates from PromeFTP 1.1.15 and 1.1.17 failed after download with an installer launch error. This release fixes the update installer, speeds up SFTP transfers, and lets you change keyboard shortcuts by clicking them.
changes: Transfers run faster, and the running transfer icon turns correctly while files move.
Updates download and install again. Builds 1.1.15 and 1.1.17 could not install because the updater helper was missing from the app.
In Preferences → Shortcuts, click a shortcut to change it, then press the new keys. Escape cancels and Delete clears it.
notice: If you run 1.1.15 or 1.1.17, install 1.1.18 once from the DMG on this release page. Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
